in_sanskrit.name: अतिशय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit words अति (ati) meaning 'beyond' and शय (shay) meaning 'measure'. The name Atishay, thus, signifies something that is beyond measure or immeasurable.

in_marathi.name: Atishay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atishay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Atishay means 'auspicious' or 'divine'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ati' meaning 'beyond' and 'shay' meaning 'fortune' or 'happiness'. In Hindu mythology, Atishay is a name associated with divine beings and the promise of good fortune.
